result.title: Déjà Vu: Cycle-Consistent Re-ranking for Semantic Correspondence
result.summary: We propose \emph{Déjà Vu}, a test-time decoding module for semantic correspondence. Matching semantically equivalent keypoints across images of the same object category is challenging due to variations in appearance, viewpoint, and scale. While features from large pretrained vision models carry strong zero-shot correspondence ability, existing methods reduce final matching to greedy top-$1$ nearest-neighbor selection. We show that the correct correspondence appears among the top-ranked candidates far more often than top-$1$ matching achieves: with $30$ candidates, zero-shot features exceed the top-$1$ accuracy of a supervised model. This reveals a \textit{decoding bottleneck} rather than a limit of the representation. Motivated by this observation, we formulate semantic correspondence as a \textit{recall-then-rerank} problem. Our method first nominates an adaptive candidate set, larger when the similarity distribution is ambiguous and smaller when it is confident, then re-ranks the candidates with a graded cycle-consistency score: each candidate is matched back to the source image and penalized by how far its reverse match lands from the original keypoint. The module operates entirely on the similarity matrix already computed by the base method. It consistently improves three representative baselines on SPair-71k, its geometric subset, and PF-Pascal under both unsupervised and weakly supervised settings, with gains of up to $+1.8$ PCK@0.10 on SPair-71k and $+3.4$ PCK@0.15 on PF-Pascal, and $+4.9$ under Keypoint Average Precision.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Déjà Vu，一个测试期的语义对应解码模块：先按相似度分布的歧义程度自适应确定候选集大小做召回，再用分级的循环一致性分数重排序，以缓解把匹配简化为贪心 top-1 的「解码瓶颈」。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「正确项常在 top-k 候选中」的诊断、按歧义程度调整候选规模、以及以反向匹配偏移作为验证分数，可能为 LVR 中视觉假设的候选筛选、置信度驱动的计算分配与停止判断提供可供核查的方法线索。
